title: Kissed Rich Croatian Meat Dumplings
description: Rich and pillowy Croatian dish featuring ground clove and wok-hei, perfect for special occasions, and is dairy-free friendly.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground beef, ground pork, chopped onion, minced garlic, ground clove, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and mix until just combined.
Gradually add the flour to the meat mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 4 of the dumplings to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until browned.
Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite sides.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
